Method of Attack: Ransomware that encrypts files on removable devices and mapped network drives only, excluding the C: drive and unmapped network shares
Distributed through malvertising that redirects users to the RIG exploit kit
RIG exploit kit uses malicious scripts exploiting Internet Explorer vulnerabilities to silently install payloads
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with removable USB drives and mapped network drives (D:, E:, F:, G:, H:, I: drives)
Attack Vector: Malvertising campaign (Hookads) leading to RIG exploit kit infection
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom notes named [extension]-readme.txt in C:\Instraction folder and on desktop
Encrypted files appended with random character extensions
